# CYBER MAIL — Unlimited Temp Mail & Disposable Gmail 🚀

> ⚡ **CYBER MAIL** (`https://cyber-mail2026.netlify.app/`) is a free, instant, unlimited temporary email & disposable Gmail web application with real-time OTP & verification link detection.
> 👑 **Developer by Rayhan (SK RAYHAN BOSS)** 💻

## 🌐 Official Website & Preview
- **Live App:** https://cyber-mail2026.netlify.app/
- **Banner / Preview Image:** https://files.catbox.moe/xghf6r.webp
- **Developer:** Rayhan (SK RAYHAN BOSS)

## ✨ Key Features & Capabilities
- 📧 **Unlimited Temp Mail & Disposable Gmail:** Generate unlimited temporary email addresses instantly with one click—no registration or password required.
- 🔑 **Real-Time OTP & Verification Link Inbox:** Automatically detects and highlights OTP codes and confirmation links as soon as emails arrive.
- ⏱️ **Flexible Session Timer:** Choose from 5 minutes, 10 minutes, 15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, or unlimited session duration.
- 🛡️ **Privacy & Spam Protection:** Keep your personal Gmail and primary inbox safe from spam, trackers, and unwanted newsletters.
- 🎨 **Matrix Cyber UI:** Futuristic dark-mode interface with customizable neon colors, themes, and background audio.
